events.title: TAIJIFU historical origin marker
events.description: The official historical 'Desde' marker is 2006, established from creator-provided records: Thales Walisson was born in 1992 and the origin is identified with age 14.
events.note: 1992 + 14 = 2006. Precision is year only; month/day are not inferred.

events.title: Modern TAIJIFU Canon/publication phase
events.description: Repository Canon Visual V1 used the wording 'Desde 2026'. This wording is preserved as evidence of the modern phase but no longer defines the historical origin of TAIJIFU.
events.note: Exact classification of the 2026 milestone (formalization, publication, relaunch or another modern phase) remains to be explicitly established.

note: TAIJIFU historical origin is canonical at year precision as 2006. Unknown month/day remain unresolved rather than inferred.
